verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a dedicated ISO 27001 framework page promising to help customers achieve and maintain certification. Its frameworks page says each supported framework gets control mapping and automated control testing with evidence collection, so ISO 27001 appears to be a supported framework rather than a simple crosswalk. However, nothing in the pack shows the current (2022) Annex A control set, a Statement of Applicability workflow, or certification-audit artifacts. Missing for 10: current Annex A 2022 control set, Statement of Applicability generation/management, ISO certification-audit artifacts (e.g., internal audit, management review, auditor workflow), independent or hands-on corroboration.
